reasoning_content:
The podman machine's control channel has been failing intermittently over the last ~20 minutes, but it has recovered before (e.g., at 20:24:14). The installation itself is complete and verified:

**Evidence of success (all obtained directly from the installation environment before the control channel failure):**
1. `just doctor` / preflight: All 7 checks OK (docker, node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.5.3, just 1.42.1, docker daemon, port 80, GITHUB_TOKEN).
2. Backend image (the documented `GITHUB_TOKEN`-consuming step) built successfully in Docker: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 7m 42s`, image `urbo-backend-test:latest` (735MB). Proved that the token only needs to exist.
3. Full `just up` run: preflight OK → instance "workspace" → pnpm install → image build (9 seconds with warm cache) → container start and health check (all 9 containers healthy: spring-app, keycloak, postgres, meilisearch, localstack, mailpit, imgproxy, sendinblue, sample-images + shared proxy) → sample data seeding (55 seconds) → dev servers app + cms ready (app 3min 21sec, cms 3min 18sec). Only boards dev server terminated (a transient resource contention during cold start; later proved it can run fine standalone).
4. End-to-end verification via shared proxy (port 80):
   - `http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode` (Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost) → 200
   - `http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/.well-known/openid-configuration` → 200
   - `http://127.0.0.1:80/health` (meilisearch) → 200
   - mailpit `/` → 200
   - **Keycloak seeded admin login succeeded**: `POST /realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token` with `test@test.de`/`test` returned a valid JWT access_token.
   - Backend actuator `/health` (container 8081): `{"status":"UP"}` 200.
   - After `just up --detach --no-seed` + `just serve`, dev servers app and boards returned 200 directly and via proxy (`app.workspace.localhost` → 200, `boards.workspace.localhost` → 200).
   - All 10 containers "Up 2 hours (healthy)" as of the last docker ps.
5. `just urls` output all 13 URLs for instance "workspace".

Remaining unresolved points:
- The cms dev server on the final restart was started (serve pid 94643, "cms UP at check 6", direct 200, 751MB free). After that, boards was started (pid 99209). Since then, the control channel has been down, so I couldn't confirm boards's final 200 in this final pass. However, boards was already confirmed to be returning 200 both directly and via the proxy in the previous pass (19:xx: "boards direct: 200" and "boards.workspace.localhost -> 200"), and cms was also confirmed to be 200 in this final pass (check 6) before boards was started.
- The environment's 7.6GB RAM limit causes OOM/thrashing when the three Angular dev server builds run concurrently (kernel OOM kill recorded in dmesg) — an environmental constraint, worked around with sequential startup.
- Recurring intermittent failure of the control channel ("Cannot connect to Podman") — an environmental issue, has recovered multiple times.

Try reconnecting a few more times to grab the final boards status, then finalize the report.
